title: Deployment-mask-aware CFR distillation
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Applying source-policy KL over the full deployment cap999 legal mask while applying CFR target loss only over solver cap1 support will prevent uncontrolled residual changes on reopened raise slots and improve policy transfer without weakening teacher fit on solved actions.
material_change: Extend compact loading to reconstruct the exact deployed legal mask for every row; retain separate teacher and deployment masks through frozen-feature metrics and training; rerun the eight-deep-board H64/source-KL1/L2=.01 adapter as a single-variable ablation.
baseline: Eight-deep legacy-mask adapter mirror4096 -0.50 bb/100 +/-0.81; teacher/deployment exact mask only about 50-68% depending topology.

result.summary: Deployment-mask-aware source preservation recovered a stable +2.01 bb/100 paired internal signal, but the unchanged frozen candidate scored -41.98 bb/100 over 5,000 fresh independent Slumbot hands, CI95 [-84.83,+0.87].
result.conclusion: Using the deployment mask for source KL prevents unintended changes on reopened raise slots, but it cannot teach those actions. Only 39.55% of fresh postflop decisions matched teacher history+pot+SPR+mask support; both seats lost, especially BB flop/turn and SB turn/river. Do not scale this checkpoint.
result.next_step: Profile exact-grid raise-cap-2 SRP and 3BP trees at low bucket/iteration resolution. If tractable, add explicit cap-2 configs and train a teacher that supplies learned targets for raise-versus-raise states rather than merely preserving the source there.
